ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring system designed to track industrial land compliance and ecological changes in real time for grassroots environmental auditors.
ideas.title: EcoTrack-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-impact environmental problem solving with sophisticated satellite monitoring techniques, directly addressing the core judging criterion of practical application for grassroots innovators.

ideas.pitch: A localized AML and credit risk detection platform tailored for rural agricultural cooperatives using graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models.
ideas.title: AgriVision-Risk
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies enterprise-grade graph intelligence and risk scoring to a localized rural context, showing judges a tangible financial application for grassroots economies.

ideas.pitch: A regional nutrition and wellness assistant that delivers personalized meal recommendations based on locally available, affordable indigenous food items.
ideas.title: NutriLocal-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles community health and grassroots nutrition with an accessible interface that juries can immediately test and understand.

ideas.pitch: A predictive municipal incident forecasting tool using Poisson regression to anticipate infrastructure failures and civic complaints across urban zones.
ideas.title: CivicIssue-Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presents rigorous statistical forecasting and calibrated prediction intervals that appeal strongly to technical judges looking for hard engineering solutions.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support and administrative query platform leveraging RAG to streamline institutional processes and grievance redressal.
ideas.title: CampusCare-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable operational problem for an educational institution, scoring high on utility and immediate campus deployment potential.
